notes.title: Announcement: "Gun Maker" Workshop Launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce the release of the workshop-based item exchange feature!

With this feature, you can share and exchange your custom-designed guns with other users through the Workshop.

## How to Use the Feature

1. Posting Items to the Workshop
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683205/640262ce9a8c8da89090ac0fa54ca0354262760a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683205/1f27dc7220e20e077ba33322f597928ba6cd5dbb.png[/img][/url]

2.Launch the game and select Workshop mode.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683205/67091be7bbd322b512e3e869520dcc73f390e5b3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683205/a9c6cc43e601d3911a75a6eb3346555974553beb.png[/img][/url]

3. Create a gun by assembling parts, then click the "MODS" button.
After clicking the "Create Item" button, input the title and detailed description, then press the "Register Item" button.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683205/244e4ede05260cf1412baf8a24dc5bc860c494fb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683205/bf6638bc9a1465ee31a74fc14a565900b39efb56.png[/img][/url]


## Using Items from the Workshop

1. Subscribe to the item you want to use on the Steam Workshop.
2. Select your desired item from the subscribed item list on the left (if it doesn’t appear, click the reload button).

3. Press the "Get Item" button to place the item in the editing screen. Subscribed items can be freely modified as you like.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683205/43e1a30cf6abf837de58267d78cc5d01a8fb80c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683205/b78ed2c86efb6b49ee594d16e7267e45996642c6.png[/img][/url]


We hope you come up with amazing, creative designs to share with everyone and enjoy this feature to the fullest!

(Please ensure you use the feature in compliance with the Workshop Terms of Use.)

notes.title: Version 1.1 released
notes.content:
Based on user feedback, we have created a new "Workshop Mode" mode for sharing weapons created in the workshop as presets.
Here you can use many parts to perform more complex editing than in normal mode.
It has been introduced as a beta version and has limited functionality.
(Sharing in the workshop is not possible at this time.)
In some cases, data may be reset during the beta version.

We believe that completing this mode will make the app even better.
It's a shame that we couldn't include it at the time of release.


Please let me know if you have any requests for parts.

Thank you/

notes.title: Release date has changed
notes.content:
Hello everyone
I would like to report that a major problem has occurred.
Due to incomplete review, we have decided to reschedule the release date for August 14th.
We apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to it and to the curators.

The new release date and time has been set for August 21st.
However, we will release it as soon as the review is completed, so it may be released earlier.

We are saddened that we will not be able to deliver the game to you tomorrow, but we are working hard to clear up some misunderstandings for our reviewers.
Please wait a little longer. I would like to deliver a game about this to everyone.

thank you
